display.purpose: Shared page titles; the homepage wordmark has its own identity sizing.

headline.purpose: Editorial section headings with explicit responsive steps.

title.purpose: The repeated collection-detail heading, not a universal h3 scale.

body.purpose: Inherited sans-serif reading baseline; Chinese body text follows the actual Microsoft YaHei fallback.

label.purpose: Object type and exhibition status below a title, never a before-title kicker.

navigation.purpose: Desktop route navigation; mobile disclosure uses its own larger label size.

collection-title.purpose: Compact object names preceding type metadata in selectable thumbnails.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Navigation background and text, thumbnail mats, and action-arrow movement.

motion.name: image-feedback
motion.purpose: Image opacity feedback on inspection triggers.

motion.name: hero-arrival
motion.purpose: Homepage content only, at min-width 961px with no reduced-motion preference; not a global entrance recipe.

motion.name: ambient-film-rate
motion.purpose: Both defaultPlaybackRate and playbackRate on the muted, inline, looping film; no on-page playback controls. The film remains visible and requests playback regardless of motion preference; autoplay denial keeps a still fallback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disable decorative interface animation and transitions and make scrolling immediate without hiding or pausing the explicitly requested ambient film.

textures.name: archive-paper
textures.purpose: Paper grain from the letter's blank margin, with uneven illumination removed, contrast limited and the crop mirrored. Used on body, masthead, exhibition and footer backgrounds, never on original object photographs. This is derived raster texture, not an AI-generated historical artifact.

components.name: Primary Action

components.name: Route Navigation
components.description: Dark route row with brass-on-mineral feedback and bold current-page state; the mobile preview shows the open menu.
components.html: AboutCollectionsExhibitionsResearchContact
components.css: .ds-primary-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 10px; color: var(--ink, #eee8db); background: var(--deep, #121914) var(--texture, url('/assets/textures/archive-paper.png')); background-blend-mode: soft-light; font-family: var(--body, 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif); font-size: .875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 10px 12px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--accent, #d5bd86); background: var(--mineral, #29332a); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current='page'] { font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #d5bd86); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 1200px) { .ds-primary-nav { gap: 6px; font-size: .8rem; } } @media (max-width: 960px) { .ds-primary-nav { justify-content: flex-start; flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; padding: 12px var(--gutter, 30px) 24px; font-size: 1.1rem; } .ds-nav-link { padding: 12px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-link { transition: none; } }

components.name: Collection Selector
components.description: Title-first object button with a brighter selected mat, brass title, checkmark and native pressed state.
components.css: .ds-collection-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; width: 100%; text-align: left; color: var(--ink, #eee8db); background: transparent; padding: 0 0 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; font-family: var(--body, 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif); font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.7; letter-spacing: 0; cursor: pointer; } .ds-collection-image { display: block; width: 100%; height: 178px; padding: 14px; background: var(--mineral, #29332a); object-fit: contain; transition: background 180ms ease; } .ds-collection-copy { display: block; padding-top: 13px; } .ds-collection-title { display: block; font-size: .91rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.55; overflow-wrap: break-word; } .ds-collection-type { display: block; font-size: .68rem; color: var(--muted, #b9c0b2); margin-top: 8px; } .ds-collection-card:hover .ds-collection-image, .ds-collection-card.ds-is-active .ds-collection-image { background: #414936; } .ds-collection-card.ds-is-active .ds-collection-title { color: var(--accent, #d5bd86); } .ds-selected-check { display: none; width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-left: 6px; vertical-align: middle; } .ds-is-active .ds-selected-check { display: inline-block; } .ds-collection-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #d5bd86); outline-offset: 5px; } @media (max-width: 1200px) { .ds-collection-image { height: 155px; } } @media (max-width: 960px) { .ds-collection-image { height: 135px; padding: 10px; } } @media (max-width: 640px) { .ds-collection-image { height: 146px; } .ds-collection-title { font-size: .83rem; } .ds-collection-type { font-size: .63rem; } } @media (max-width: 360px) { .ds-collection-image { height: 125px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-collection-image { transition: none; } }

narrative.overview:
MOFER's original photographs, documents and film lead a quiet, dark museum site. Charcoal and olive surfaces fit the film's palette; muted wine distinguishes exhibitions and brass marks actions. Subtle paper grain adds texture to the surrounding interface.

Display serifs, compact sans-serif controls and efficient spacing support reading in Chinese and English. ROM, AGO and MoMA inform hierarchy and image presentation, with less visual flourish than AGO. Tonal fields and spacing separate content without white canvases or decorative dividing lines.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal fields with subtle raster paper grain.
Original object images remain contained and untextured.
Compact, title-first layouts with visible keyboard focus.
Chinese-first bilingual pages and quarter-speed ambient film.

rules.name: The Quiet Accent Rule
rules.body: Brass marks actions, selection and keyboard focus against dark surfaces; it does not recolor the historical media.

rules.name: The Title First Rule
rules.body: Give headings and object names priority; place classification and exhibition status below them.

rules.name: The Flat Gallery Rule
rules.body: Use tonal fields, subtle paper grain and spacing for depth; keep texture off original object photographs and avoid imitation bevels.

dos: Do keep original object images fully visible and free of texture overlays.
Do place names and headings before type and status metadata.
Do use compact responsive spacing and let both languages wrap naturally.
Do preserve substantive bilingual facts while editing prose for clarity.
Do retain visible focus, labelled controls, dialog focus return and motion-preference fallbacks.
Do use the existing local fonts, Lucide icons and historical media.
donts: Don't add white canvases, decorative dividing lines or above-title kickers.
Don't turn sections into floating cards or add bevels, offset shadows or pill controls.
Don't add visible film playback controls or promise playback despite browser and motion preferences.
Don't invent historical evidence, visitor services or approval and rights claims.
Don't use wordmark-sized type in compact controls or scale fonts with viewport width.
Don't replace Lucide icons with glyphs or treat sidecar tonal ramps as site colors.
